name: product-passport
title: Product passport
description: A digital product passport: what it is made of, where it was made, certifications, care and repair, and how to recycle it.
docs: Pass the parts you know and leave out the rest: a section without content is not drawn, never shown empty. materials ({ name, share in percent, note? }) draw one stacked bar with a list under it that writes every share in words, so the bar is never the only carrier of the numbers (the bar itself is hidden from screen readers); when the shares come to less than 100 the bar says 'Other materials' for the rest instead of claiming more than it knows. origin is { place, factory?, year?, note? }. certificates are { name, issuer?, number?, href }: each one is a real link to the certificate, opens in a new tab and says so to a screen reader. footprint is { value ('8.4 kg CO₂e'), label?, method? } with the method in one line. care, repair and endOfLife are lists of { title, detail?, icon?, href?, linkLabel? } in an accordion; defaultOpen says which of them start open (all three by default, [] for none). updatedAt is a Date, an ISO string or epoch milliseconds, and a plain yyyy-mm-dd is a calendar day; title and identifier name the product and the passport. locale writes the percentages and the date, timeZone reads updatedAt, headingAs is 'h3' inside a section that has its own h2 (the section titles, and the accordion's, go one level below it), and labels holds the fixed words. Apart from the accordion it keeps no state, so it renders on the server.
